answer_1.quote: for multilingual and cross-lingual tasks, the sequential instructions can contain intermediate tasks like translation (often to English), whereas for multi-or cross-modal tasks, this can be speech-to-text transcription or image-to-text captioning.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to sequential instructions, including translations, captions, paraphrases, code, and answers to queries.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-L (R-L) and BERTScore (BS) on the repeated content and human-counted success rate (%) of models following instructions.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4-Turbo to directly score the quality of each model response on a scale of 1 to 5. We also ask the judge LLM to produce a binary judgement of whether all questions are fulfilled.

answer_4.quote: otherwise, we use human inspection or GPT-4-Turbo to verify if a model follows all instructions.
answer_4.guideline: Verify if the model produces an output for all tasks in the instruction, regardless of correctness.
